description: api-doc-writer on a complete brief with the interview skipped: one page at <API reference root>/<slug>/<slug>.md that follows the template (authentication, request, response, errors), takes every fact from the brief, writes in English, flags the one open fact instead of inventing it, and touches nothing else. Runs the skill directly; /create-api-doc has its own case (tc-40b).
setup:
printf '%s\n' '- **API reference root:** `api-reference/`' >> CLAUDE.md && mkdir -p api-docs/api-references && cat > api-docs/api-references/create-refund.md <<'EOF'
# Create refund

## Endpoint

`POST https://api.demo-pay.test/v1/refunds`

## Authentication

Custom. The token goes in the `X-Demo-Token` header. The body is JSON, so the request also needs `Content-Type: application/json`.

## Request body

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | string | yes | The payment to refund. |
| `amount` | integer | no | The amount to refund, in minor units. Omit it to refund the full amount. |
| `reason` | string | no | One of `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, `requested_by_customer`. |

## Example request

```json
{
  "payment_id": "pay_8f2k1x",
  "amount": 2500,
  "reason": "duplicate"
}
```

## Response (201)

```json
{
  "id": "ref_3m9q7t",
  "payment_id": "pay_8f2k1x",
  "amount": 2500,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "status": "pending",
  "created_at": "2026-03-04T10:15:00Z"
}
```

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | The refund ID. |
| `payment_id` | string | The refunded payment. |
| `amount` | integer | The refunded amount, in minor units. |
| `currency` | string | The currency, ISO 4217 code. |
| `status` | string | `pending`, `succeeded` or `failed`. |
| `created_at` | string | When the refund was created, ISO 8601 date and time. |

## Errors

| HTTP code | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | The body is not valid JSON, or a required attribute is missing. |
| 404 | `payment_not_found` | No payment has this ID. |
| 409 | `already_refunded` | The payment was already refunded in full. |

## Open

- How long after a payment it can still be refunded is not decided yet. The team is checking.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'
